title: The Label Horizon Paradox: Rethinking Supervision Targets in Financial Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2602.03395v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While deep learning has revolutionized financial forecasting through sophisticated architectures, the design of the supervision signal itself is rarely scrutinized. We challenge the canonical assumption that training labels must strictly mirror inference targets, uncovering the Label Horizon Paradox: the optimal supervision signal often deviates from the prediction goal, shifting across intermediate horizons governed by market dynamics. We theoretically ground this phenomenon in a dynamic signal-noise trade-off, demonstrating that generalization hinges on the competition between marginal signal realization and noise accumulation. To operationalize this insight, we propose a bi-level optimization framework that autonomously identifies the optimal proxy label within a single training run. Extensive experiments on large-scale financial datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over conventional baselines, thereby opening new avenues

translated_title: 标签地平线悖论：重新思考金融预测中的监督目标
translated_abstract: 摘要：虽然深度学习通过复杂架构彻底改变了金融预测，但监督信号本身的设计却很少受到审视。我们挑战了训练标签必须严格反映推理目标的经典假设，揭示了标签地平线悖论：最优监督信号往往偏离预测目标，而是在市场动态所决定的中间地平线上移动。我们从理论上将这一现象归结为动态信噪权衡，证明泛化能力取决于边际信号实现与噪声累积之间的竞争。为了将这一见解付诸实践，我们提出了一种双层优化框架，能够在单次训练运行中自主识别最优代理标签。在大规模金融数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法相比传统基线具有持续改进，从而开辟了新的研究方向。
tldr: 本文发现金融预测中监督信号的最优设计应偏离最终目标，提出双层优化框架自动选择中间代理标签，显著提升模型泛化性能。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that optimal supervision signals in financial forecasting deviate from inference targets, proposing a bi-level optimization framework to autonomously select intermediate proxy labels, consistently improving generalization.
